declared_data_period: End of March 2026, according to the publisher description on Kaggle.
github_license: No separate license file found in the GitHub repository. Applicability of the Kaggle license to this raw GitHub file has not been independently established.
local_modifications: none; original bytes from the pinned GitHub commit preserved
status: Prepared and evaluated on 2026-10-12: 3759 cleaned March rows saved separately; March model trained and compared on a shared 594-row holdout. January remains active by user choice because its holdout MAE is lower. See reports/march_update/update_report.json.

mapping_notes.price: price: full price in KZT; source strings use the character 〒 (U+3012), requiring an explicit normalization rule.
mapping_notes.area: Площадь: parse total area in square metres; preserve missing values and reject ambiguous values.
mapping_notes.rooms: title: parse room count from the apartment title.
mapping_notes.floor: Этаж: parse current floor where provided; do not replace missing floors with whole-dataset medians.
mapping_notes.total_floors: Этаж: parse total building floors where provided.
mapping_notes.district: Город: parse city and district; keep Сарайшык separate from Сарыарка.
mapping_notes.url: url: canonical listing URL; verify duplicates and overlap with January data before evaluation.
mapping_notes.collected_at: Unavailable at row level. Do not substitute fetched_at_utc or Git commit date as observation dates.

known_caveats: Only the publisher-declared period (end of March 2026) is known; there is no per-row collection timestamp.
Kaggle lastUpdated, GitHub commit date and fetched_at_utc are publication/retrieval metadata, not observation dates.
The Kaggle publication declares CC0: Public Domain. The GitHub repository has no separate license file; the raw file license scope remains unverified.
The source is asking prices from advertisements, not verified sale transaction prices.
The publisher prepared CSV should not replace this raw file: cleaning_preparing.ipynb maps Сарайшык to Сарыаркинский район and imputes floors using the full dataset.
Schema is adapted by march_data.py rather than passed directly to clean.py; optional missing values remain unfilled before training.
Validation excluded 554 non-exact prices, 686 duplicate URLs, 3 feature duplicates and 1 price outside fixed bounds. Overlap checks are conservative and cannot rule out all repeat apartments.
No Krisha scraping was performed. Model training was performed separately after validation; original raw bytes remain unchanged.

related_official_aggregate.description: Housing price indices and prices, September 2026; official aggregates, not apartment rows.
